notes: Unselected planes are copied from the REFERENCE input, not the source as the scope line says: threshold_slice calls av_image_copy_plane(dst, ..., ref, ...). Implemented and tested as native does (a source-copy mutation fails the matrix test).

[FS-OPTS] says accept shortest, but vf_maskedthreshold declares no framesync options: native refuses shortest, eof_action, repeatlast and ts_sync_mode with 'Option not found' (probed). They are refused here too; the step's shortest is always false. Sync semantics are vf_stack's (sync=1, EXT_STOP before, EXT_INFINITY after), matched with unequal lengths.

tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts always runs a linear chain, which a join cannot have, so the per-source negotiation test mirrors its graph/stream/actor/timed and CLI checks inside the differential file (helper used read-only for negotiationSources). A join-aware option in the helper would let later joins reuse it; not required for this branch.
Native creates (empty) output files before failing graph configuration; the refusal test asserts native output is empty and that EdgeFFmpeg opens no output.

Setup: Node 24 could not be installed (npm-based Node download was denied by the sandbox policy), so bootstrap (which requires Node 24) was replaced by the documented fallback: git submodule update --init upstream/ffmpeg (47 s), npm ci (8 s), npm run reference:build (2 min 41 s). All tests ran on Node v22.23.5. Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry test: green, 1 min 11 s.
Differential file runs in about 16 s with --maxWorkers=1. No linux-gated cases: integer kernels only.
